verdict.rationale: Datalab lets users chain processors into versioned pipelines deployed to production, and run published agent processors. Jobs run asynchronously with webhook notifications on completion, so no polling is needed. However, every job still has to be started by the caller's own API or SDK request; there is no evidence of self-starting automations. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring runs, event triggers (e.g. watch folders or inbound file sources), a first-party autonomous automation runner, and independent hands-on corroboration.
